recommendations.action: Investigate playlist visibility and recovery, and review confusing or inconsistent listening and ad experiences.

recommendations.action: Review privacy controls and third-party access protections, and make data collection and deletion options clear and reliable.
recommendations.rationale: This issue has a high priority score, and the supplied reviews raise concerns about personal information, unwanted activity, and possible third-party access.

recommendations.action: Investigate failures to start or continue playback and improve diagnosis of loading and network-error reports.
recommendations.rationale: Playback ranks prominently by priority score, and the supplied reviews describe songs not playing, persistent loading, and network errors despite connectivity.

recommendations.action: Review cancellation and subscription-charge handling, including how users can verify cancellation and raise disputed charges.
recommendations.rationale: Billing has a substantial priority score, and the supplied reviews describe unexpected charges after cancellation or for a subscription another person reportedly did not use.

recommendations.action: Investigate login persistence and mobile-number sign-in, and review recovery options for accounts and saved content.
recommendations.rationale: Access has the highest mean severity among the listed issues, and the supplied reviews report being logged out, difficulty signing in, and lost liked songs.

recommendations.action: Review missing or inaccessible tracks and libraries, and clarify which search and playback features are available across plans.
recommendations.rationale: Catalog complaints include reports of missing songs, unavailable playlists, and frustration about access to basic features.
